title: SREV-021 UAC slave thread handle ownership

createthread_shape.description: CreateThread returns a thread handle on success; CloseHandle on a thread handle does not terminate the thread

ownership_contract.description: API contract is handle ownership, not worker lifetime; creators not needing to wait/signal/query the handle must close it; closing the handle is not a cancellation mechanism

fire_forget_topology.description: RunUacSlave2Thread1 runs elevated ShellExecuteExW or fails closed then exits helper process; RunUacSlave2Thread2 watches caller process and exits helper when caller exits; no later code waits/signals/duplicates/queries the returned handles

close_invariant.description: Both already-admin and dialog-confirmed branches store the CreateThread return into a local handle, check non-NULL, and CloseHandle immediately

scope_invariant.description: Patch does not change UAC prompt flow, helper thread entry points, process lifetime, or suspended-caller thread behavior

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: already-admin and dialog-confirmed paths both create workers without handle growth; elevation cancellation still routes through fail-closed; caller-process exit still terminates helper

contracts: Non-NULL thread handle returned by CreateThread must be closed when not retained for wait/signal/query
Both fire-and-forget CreateThread sites close the returned handle in their own branch
CloseHandle is not used as worker cancellation
Helper thread entry point and process lifetime are unchanged
